verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents registrable webhooks and an Events API, but only for Directory Sync: directory, group and user changes are delivered via webhooks or retrieved through the Events API. The Rust SDK also ships webhook helpers. The pack never shows these webhooks or event streams covering AuthKit sign-up or sign-in events, so only the 'user changes' part of the story is clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented webhook or event coverage for sign-ups and sign-ins, an event-type catalog, delivery and retry or signature details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
